summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a 6-K reporting daily share repurchases under its buy-back announced 5 August 2026, executed by BNP Paribas Financial Markets SNC. On 21 September 2026, HSBC purchased 10,000 ordinary shares on UK Venues at a VWAP of US$15.3842 and 580,000 shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange at HK$160.7608, all for cancellation. Cumulative repurchases since commencement total 40,198,897 shares for approximately US$827.1 million. Issued ordinary share capital and total voting rights stand at 17,146,189,100 shares. No board recommendation or advisor was named; watch for continued buy-back pace and Hong Kong cancellation timing.
